thread.title: Jim Cramer Shares His Thoughts On Johnson & Johnson, Nike And More

author: Craig Jones
title: Jim Cramer Shares His Thoughts On Johnson & Johnson, Nike And More
text:
Jim Cramer said on CNBC's "Mad Money Lightning Round" he likes Johnson & Johnson (NYSE: JNJ ).
Pure Storage Inc (NYSE: PSTG ) is a buy, thinks Cramer. He added that the company has a very smart management.
Cramer isn't a buyer of Frontline Ltd (NYSE: FRO ). He has never liked the very large crude carriers.
Gulfport Energy Corporation (NASDAQ: GPOR ) isn't high enough quality for Cramer. He thinks the stock is way down in the food chain. He would buy Schlumberger Limited. (NYSE: SLB ) instead.
Cramer isn't willing to recommend the components players that go into Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ). He isn't a buyer of Cirrus Logic, Inc. (NASDAQ: CRUS ).
Foot Locker, Inc. (NYSE: FL ) is all right, said Cramer. He prefers Nike Inc (NYSE: NKE ).
Cramer thinks Insperity Inc (NYSE: NSP ) is a buy. He has been recommending it for ages.
Cramer isn't a buyer of Preferred Apartment Communities, Inc. (NYSE: APTS ). He sees the 7 percent yield as a red flag and he doesn't like multi-family segment.
